lastCompletedStory.title: Rename grill vocabulary in recovery-runbook and patterns.md

openQuestions: One transient full-suite `bun run check:all` run reported '4852 pass / 1 fail' before any edits in this story landed on disk beyond the two doc files; 6 subsequent consecutive re-runs (bare `bun test` and full `bun run check:all`) were all clean (4853 pass / 0 fail, exit 0). The failing test's name was not captured in that single anomalous run. This story's diff is docs-only (recovery-runbook.md, patterns.md) with zero source/test changes, so it cannot be the cause. patterns.md already documents a known class of full-suite-CPU-load-induced test timing flakes (dashboard.test.ts / ink-testing-library terminal-size shellout, CAM-201) that were mitigated but may not be fully eliminated under heavy machine load. Recommend the next story that touches test infra re-run the full suite a few times under load to see if this reproduces and, if so, capture the failing test name for a targeted fix.
nextStoryContext: US-005 (FRONT C, recovery-runbook + patterns.md) is done. docs/recovery-runbook.md section (u) (heading, prose ~1686-1841): every 'grill'/'grill-with-docs' token renamed to 'spec interview'/'spec-with-docs', including all three by-path refs to `.claude/skills/spec-with-docs/SKILL.md` (the actual on-disk skill dir is already named spec-with-docs from a prior story). Both files confirmed `! grep -q grill <file>` clean. Full spine green on final run: bun run typecheck (0 errors), bun test (4853 pass / 0 fail, run repeatedly), bun run check:all (test/embed-vendor/lint/file-size/debt-markers/version-skips/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps all ok; no vendor/templates touched so embed-vendor was a no-op confirm). Neither file is embedded (templates/scripts/cam/patterns.md already has 0 grill tokens per US-004 handoff note; recovery-runbook.md lives under docs/ not templates/), so no embed regen and no dual-copy edit was needed. This closes out the grill-vocabulary-rename PRD front (FRONT C); check prd.json for any remaining non-operator stories before assuming PRD_COMPLETE.
